dedupe_keys.name: elmada electricity emission and price data tool

description: elmada is a Python tool from the DrafProject developers for obtaining electricity carbon-emission factors and wholesale prices. It supports European countries through merit-order methods, with an additional generation-based method for Germany. The repository documents cached Parquet data for 20 countries during 2017 to 2020 and a live mode using external data services. Temporal resolution can be as fine as a quarter hour, while country coverage depends on the method. Results are exposed as Pandas Series and DataFrames for use in energy-management calculations. The code is public and free under LGPL-3.0; external datasets retain their own terms. This supports emissions-sensitive dispatch and comparison of electricity-use schedules. A limitation is that live data access may require user API keys, and the documented local-standard-time convention ignores daylight-saving changes. Existing data-entsoe-transparency-platform is a documented upstream source. This review verified the code and README without obtaining credentials, requesting live time series or treating the cached period as current observations.
